data.title: School — Beginner · Lesson 1
data.subject: school
data.lyrics:
[Intro]
Hey there… Hey there…

[Hook]
Hello… Hola
How are you?… ¿Cómo estás?
Let's learn… Aprendamos
One, two, three… Uno, dos, tres
Come sing along with me.

[Verse]
At the café, sipping my drink,
the school… la escuela, it's where we think.
Open the book… el libro, turn the page,
the pencil… el lápiz, ready to engage.
On the paper… el papel, we write our dreams,
the student… el estudiante, in this world it seems.
We laugh and chat, sharing our day,
good morning… buenos días, let's seize the day.

[Hook]
Hello… Hola
How are you?… ¿Cómo estás?
Let's learn… Aprendamos
One, two, three… Uno, dos, tres
Come sing along with me.

[Verse]
The sun is shining through the window pane,
thank you… gracias, for this moment, plain and sane.
We practice words, we learn and grow,
the future's bright… el futuro es brillante, watch it glow.
With every phrase, we build a bridge,
the language of life… el idioma de la vida, a sweet pledge.
We sip our coffee, time flies by,
